title: Dynamic Inference Config Marketplace — initiative roadmap for unit-cost reduction
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a self-serve marketplace of vetted inference configurations (presets) that teams can apply per-route or per-model to reduce per-token unit cost while preserving application quality. Each preset bundles batching profiles, prefix/KV caching policies, and quantization options with metadata about expected latency, throughput, and quality regressions. The initiative will: 1) define the preset schema and validation rules; 2) curate initial preset catalog (low-latency, low-cost, high-throughput, mixed); 3) build console and API surfaces to discover/apply presets; 4) instrument A/B rollout and evaluation hooks for quality/regression monitoring.
acceptance_criteria: Preset schema v1 documented (fields: name, compatible-models, batch_profile, cache_policy, quant_profile, expected_metrics)
API to list, get, and apply presets available in Redwood API (authenticated)
Console UX to preview estimated cost/latency impact for a route; apply or schedule rollout
Telemetry captures pre/post metrics for key routes (tokens/s, p95 latency, quality regression delta) for A/B
Three curated presets published (latency-safe, throughput-max, cost-min) and validated on internal workloads
Rollback and automatic fallback defined and tested (can revert to previous preset within 5 minutes)

okrs: OKR-1: Reduce average hosted per-token cost for pilot routes by 18% without >1% quality regression
OKR-2: Achieve adoption of presets on 30% of new routes created by platform teams within first 60 days
OKR-3: Provide transparent cost/latency estimates in Console for 95% of catalog presets
roadmap_notes: We will prioritize presets that require no model re-training (quantized variants + runtime batching/caching) to maximize short-term impact.
Longer term: integrate with Optimize's recommendation engine to propose presets automatically based on workload traces.
Conservative rollout policy will start with internal routes -> opt-in customers -> gradual defaulting for eligible low-impact routes.
Design will expose expected unit cost delta and confidence band in the preview pane to set expectations for PMs/engineers.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Quantization presets could introduce unacceptable regressions on some models. Mitigation: gate quantization presets behind model compatibility list and require offline evals before rollout.
Risk: Overpromising cost estimates in Console. Mitigation: show confidence intervals and link to underlying workload assumptions; instrument pre-flight simulation for common route traces.
Risk: Preset proliferation leading to maintenance burden. Mitigation: introduce lifecycle policy (deprecation, telemetry-driven pruning) and require owner for curated presets.
Risk: Cross-team dependency on serving runtime kernel changes. Mitigation: provide shim presets that use existing runtime kernels and mark advanced presets as beta until kernel rollout completes.
